scope: Repair an unclosed bookkeeping window after a completed asynchronous worker and an inactive task interval; never reset historical recorded charges
closure_interpretation: Inferred worker-end bound with five-minute unmetered cleanup reserve at 17.6 core-hours per wall hour; not measured process CPU time. Native solver is terminal, full audit exists, final wrapper operation returns after atomic audit write and slot unlock; old session is missing and no owned solver/postprocessor/test process remains.
inactive_interval_basis: Task continuation was paused; no remaining programmed work after final audit and no subsequent owned attempt. Unclosed state alone is not evidence of computing throughout the pause.
preserved: Historical CPU reserve, all earlier windows, all failed/unknown attempt charges and all caps remain unchanged
